goal: H-245 independent module worlds and flat runtime TLS architecture

build.note: Source-only frontend changes; existing default graph ran runtimes dependencies. No configuration edits or explicit bootstrap targets.

requirements.requirement: Receiver-only module construction; foreign-world editing impossible at compile time and runtime
source: cod/lang_frontend.hh: Module / ModuleWorld; dependency; select_callable; select_type; select_associated_methods
requirements.assessment: Selection reads const source worlds and writes receiver-owned containers. Callable bodies/identities can be shared without sharing mutable selection tables. Generated runtime operations access values/bindings, not module-world editing APIs.

requirements.requirement: Identity-centered information, local merge and multiple aliases
source: cod/lang_frontend.hh: CallableIdentity; ModuleWorld.callables/imported_callables; merge_callable; extend_imported_callable; select_type
requirements.assessment: Aliases select canonical records. Same-type conformance information from separate adapters is visible through either receiver alias; its source helper remains isolated. Local union identities do not replace separately saved identities.

requirements.requirement: Explicit exported identity/alias boundaries and onward publication
source: cod/lang_frontend.hh: PublishedIdentity; published; publish; publish_declarations; select_associated_methods
requirements.assessment: Source selections read the public identity map independently of local lookup. Private resources and unexported selections reject; associated methods do not bypass export privacy.

requirements.requirement: Separate module worlds and flattened typed runtime TLS
source: cod/lang_frontend.hh: ModuleWorld versus Environment; symbol_types_; fix_type
evidence: K395: cross-world TLS native trace and two thread_local ptr declarations
requirements.assessment: Symbol identity indexes native TLS independently of module aliases and declared type identity. WPO validates declared types and availability. Runtime changes/restores pointer cells; statically known region/procedure associations specialize to native values and checked compile-time call metadata.

requirements.requirement: Compatible values from independent worlds; capture-by-value/current execution and restoration
source: cod/lang_frontend.hh: define_procedure; bind; read_symbol; invoke; block
requirements.assessment: Two module-owned source values share vocabulary types/symbols. Captured and current calls, repeated loop shadowing/restoration and later referent mutation are exercised. Capture preserves a reference value rather than copying its referent; no foreign method-world mutation results.

requirements.requirement: Regional scope, hidden/captured owners and invalid-access rejection
source: cod/lang_frontend.hh: holdings_; region_pointer; bind; close_holdings; execute_module
evidence: K395: region-owner-capture.cod; cross-world TLS probe; region-pool.cod
requirements.assessment: Owners are tracked separately from binding visibility. Module owners remain until normal program exit; inner owners use scope cleanup. Hiding/replaying captures does not free/extract the original resource. Escaping views and extraction from a dynamic region binding reject.

requirements.requirement: Vocabulary shared typed-symbol, abstract/data-type and method identities
evidence: K395: world-composition.cod; abstract-forwarding.cod; module-diamond.cod; cross-world TLS vocabulary
requirements.assessment: Vocabulary selection preserves identities in independently constructed worlds. Distinct same-spelled symbols/types stay distinct. Abstract method dispatch and local explicit conformance use the selected identity information.

requirements.requirement: Internal callable construction and coherent conflict handling
source: cod/lang_frontend.hh: ImplementationContext; lookup_methods; selected_method; typed method selection
evidence: K395: method-context-selection.cod; method-dependency-conflict.cod; method-nested-conflict.cod; 64-module imported/frozen paths
requirements.assessment: Compiler interpretation contexts stay internal. Using preserves source context, import composes receiver-selected information, and inherited/sibling conflicts reject per H253 rather than selecting a winner by common origin. Direct aliases remain distinct.

requirements.requirement: Multi-alias extension warning and opt-in error
evidence: K395: method-context-selection.cod default warning and -Werror=multi-alias-extension; unit warning category independence
requirements.assessment: Declarations through multiple aliases of one identity warn, without forbidding multiple aliases. The targeted option promotes that warning to an error.

requirements.requirement: Coordinated design, supersession and authority history
evidence: Registry H245 correction, H253 supersession and K396 audit; current document links/revisions; append-only history comparison
requirements.assessment: The architecture implementation is complete; full product-document qualification remains pending-human. No RTTI, ownership or conflict-arbitration choice is inferred. D13 reviewed without changes.

evidence: cmake --build ./build exited0 after final source edit; current audit changes documentation/evidence only
requirements.assessment: No test scripts or new build/configuration commands executed in this audit. Prior default build graph ran its existing runtimes dependencies; no explicit bootstrap/toolchain targets or configuration edits. Unrelated work remains uncommitted and untouched by this audit.
